description.value:
You become of an avatar of deceit and emit an aura of treacherous magic in a 30-ft emanation. As a Bonus Action, you gain the following benefits for 10 minutes:

  • When a creature targets you with an attack, but any of your allies are within the aura and within range of the attack, it makes the roll with Disadvantage.
  • As part of the Bonus Action to activate this feature and as a Bonus Action on every subsequent turn, you can give yourself Advantage on one Attack Roll.
  • When you use your Treacherous Strikes feature, the new target of the attack can be anywhere in the aura.

Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a Long Rest, unless you expend a 5th-level spell slot to use it again.
